objects.taxonomy_description: Asian proboscidean measuring 250-300 cm at shoulder weighing 3000-5000 kg. Body massive with thick wrinkled gray-brown skin and sparse body hair. Head broad with twin-domed skull. Ears relatively small compared to African elephant. Trunk (proboscis) elongated and muscular with single finger-like projection at tip. Tusks present primarily in males, shorter than African species. Body barrel-shaped with arched back. Legs pillar-like with five toenails on forefeet. Tail long with terminal tuft. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart.

objects.taxonomy_description: Swift leporid mammal measuring 45-70 cm body length with elongated body and powerful hind limbs. Fur dense in brown, gray, or seasonal white coloration. Ears exceptionally long (10-15 cm) with black tips. Hind legs massively elongated with muscular thighs enabling rapid leaping at speeds exceeding 60 km/h. Forelegs shorter. Tail short. Young born precocial with full fur coat and open eyes. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, fur insulation, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Timid behavior with cryptic resting posture. Larger than rabbit with longer ears and legs.

objects.taxonomy_description: Light-duty motor vehicle with an enclosed cab for passengers and an open cargo bed at the rear. Bed length ranges from 1.5 to 2.5 meters. Exterior constructed from painted steel or aluminum panels. Wheel arches protrude above the bed sides. Front end features a prominent grille, headlights, and bumper. Ground clearance is elevated (20-30 cm) compared to passenger cars. Overall length 5.0-6.5 meters. Distinguishing features include open rear cargo bed, tailgate mechanism, cab-to-bed transition, and utilitarian truck proportions.
